import numpy as np, torch, model
net=model.load(); torch.manual_seed(3)
N=4096; cs=torch.rand(N); xs=torch.randn(N,2); R=torch.relu
def dec(graft=None):
    x=xs.clone(); St=[x.clone()]
    for k in range(20):
        t=torch.full((N,),1-k/20)
        v,_=net.velocity(x,t,cs,(),count=False)
        if graft is not None: v=v+graft(x,t,cs,k)
        x=x-v/20; St.append(x.clone())
    return x.numpy(), torch.stack(St).numpy()

c=cs.numpy(); ang=np.degrees(np.arctan2(a0[:,1],a0[:,0])); r=np.linalg.norm(a0,axis=1)
# refine theta(c)=th0+s*(c-0.8): iterate peak finding
th0,s=-82.,69.
for it in range(3):
    pred=th0+s*(c-0.8); d=(ang-pred+180)%360-180
    m=(np.abs(d)<18)&(r>2.4)
    A=np.c_[np.ones(m.sum()),c[m]-0.8]; co=np.linalg.lstsq(A,ang[m],rcond=None)[0]; th0,s=co

def trk(a):
    an=np.degrees(np.arctan2(a[:,1],a[:,0])); d=(an-(th0+s*(c-0.8))+180)%360-180
    return (np.abs(d)<15)&(np.linalg.norm(a,axis=1)>2.4)
